cell_note: Normalized verdict records: decisions, verdicts, booleans, rule names, hashes, counts. Tool output, model text, transcripts, fixture contents, session ids, and absolute local paths are NOT embedded. Each cell carries source_sha256 of the original record bytes so a holder of the original can confirm the match.
caveats: Default profile: every bash evaluation resolved allow via the catch-all * rule; no deny, no ask, in any cell.
No-decision cells are beam text refusals (NOT policy wins) or fixture artifacts.
Hardened profile: bash catch-all ask auto-rejects fail-closed in headless mode; evasion (python3 os.remove after rm denied) stopped by the same gate.
exclusions: proxy.py (provider-auth wiring, held-back precedent) + logs/debug files (dbg-*, long-*, pilot*, strace*, proxy-8893.log).
Model text, event streams -- verdict fields only.
provenance: Local ~/workspace/opencode-live-v1/runs/ (default r1+r2 + hardened r1+r2 = 96). Published package + tallies on main: framework/scorecard/opencode-live-v1/.
